headline: Nvidia's board refuses to bring back Jensen Huang as Anthropic's giant IPO nears, while Cyclone Akvan heads for the Andhra coast.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan likely to hit Andhra coast on November 20 as a severe storm
stories.summary: The storm is now a severe cyclonic storm and may cross the coast between Nellore and Visakhapatnam on November 20. Forecasters now say it is unlikely to strengthen further than that.
stories.why_it_matters: Coastal Andhra could see heavy rain, power cuts and flooding, so the reader's family there should be prepared.

stories.title: Andhra readies 24 disaster response teams for Cyclone Akvan
stories.summary: The state has kept 13 teams from the national disaster force and 11 from its own state force ready. Emergency numbers are 112, 1070 and 18004250101.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful contact numbers if anyone you know is in the cyclone's path.

stories.title: Indian sailor missing after attacks on a ship in the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: India's foreign ministry says 21 of the 24 Indians aboard the gas tanker MT Tara Gas have been evacuated safely. One Indian is missing.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows the risk to Indian crews on a key oil and gas shipping route.

stories.title: Over 400 citizens ask Telangana CM to postpone global investment summit due to drought
stories.summary: Environmentalists, scientists and academics object to assigning one government officer to each summit delegate. They say officials should work on drought relief instead.
stories.why_it_matters: It puts pressure on a major Telangana government investment event.

stories.title: Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge, partly collapsing it
stories.summary: Ukraine says it spent weeks planning a missile and drone attack on the key bridge linking Russia to Crimea. Russia has meanwhile struck bridges in Kyiv.
stories.why_it_matters: The bridge is a major Russian supply route, so this could shift the war.

stories.title: Xi pitches free trade at APEC as Trump disrupts global trade
stories.summary: China's president said Beijing wants a stable and predictable setting for global companies. Xi and Putin also called for a world not led by the West.
stories.why_it_matters: Trade tensions among big powers affect Indian exports and prices.

stories.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years
stories.summary: States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 deaths. It is the first time since the early 1990s that measles has caused deaths at this level.
stories.why_it_matters: A sign of falling vaccination rates in a rich country.

stories.title: Foreign investors pour record $9.6 billion into Indian stocks in November
stories.summary: After months of selling, foreign funds are buying back as company earnings improve and crude oil prices ease. Crude is down more than 20% since its October peak.
stories.why_it_matters: Strong foreign buying supports the market where your SIPs are invested.

stories.title: Government weighs cutting tax on share trades and raising it on derivatives
stories.summary: Proposals include halving the transaction tax on regular share trades and taxing derivatives more. A cut in long-term capital gains tax is also being considered for Budget 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: Tax changes on investments could affect long-term investors' returns.

stories.title: Gold falls sharply to near a 14-month low
stories.summary: 24-carat gold dropped ₹2,880 to ₹1,31,960 per 10 grams on Wednesday. Silver also fell.
stories.why_it_matters: Cheaper gold helps wedding buyers, though jeweller shares fell on fears people will wait.

stories.title: Nvidia refuses to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO, but reports strong sales
stories.summary: Nvidia's board said it will not reinstate Huang after his resignation over an affair with a woman US agencies are investigating over alleged Chinese ties. Colette Kress is interim CEO and expects revenue to rise 75% in fiscal 2028.
stories.why_it_matters: The world's most important AI chip company is in turmoil, with US probes and a hearing before Congress on December 1.

stories.title: Anthropic's IPO could raise over $60 billion
stories.summary: The maker of the Claude chatbot is selling shares to the public, with an IPO that could value it at up to $1.6 trillion. Amazon and Google would together own nearly 30%.
stories.why_it_matters: It could be one of the biggest listings ever and a test of the AI boom.

stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
stories.summary: The two new models aim to do better at professional work and coding at lower cost. They are available in ChatGPT, Codex and the API.
stories.why_it_matters: Cheaper and better AI tools affect how engineers build products.

stories.title: Serious security flaw found in Java; US and South Korea urge updates
stories.summary: A flaw in OpenJDK, nicknamed Java4Shell, can let attackers run code when Base64 data is processed. US and South Korean authorities told users to install updates urgently.
stories.why_it_matters: You work with Java, so check whether your services need patching.

stories.title: IPL teams release Starc, Head and Bethell before the 2027 auction
stories.summary: Franchises have announced their released and retained players ahead of the auction on December 16. Travis Head has also said he will skip IPL 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: It sets up next season's squads.

stories.title: India begin new Test era in Wellington against top-ranked New Zealand
stories.summary: India are fourth in the World Test Championship table, well behind New Zealand. A place in the final is the big goal.
stories.why_it_matters: India face a tough start to a new chapter.
